• Ensure accuracy of the balance sheet workbook

• Perform source document filing spot checks

• Calculate monthly sales tax prepayments and submit to the Controller for review and payment

• Review the final P&L scrub and approve journal entries prepared by the StaffAccountant

• Review and finalize financial notes in the financial package

• Review financial statements and supporting schedules prepared by the Staff Accountant

• Understand the purpose of existing KPIs and roll them forward each month

• Confirm financial accuracy across statements, KPIs, executive summaries, charts, graphs, and footnotes

• Provide feedback to Staff Accountants about technical updates to improve their technical accounting skills

• Review process and procedural documents

Quarterly

• Complete 941 reconciliations

• Prepare and submit sales tax returns with Controller approval

Annually

• Coordinate, review, and submit 1099s annually

• Review the chart of accounts

• Reclassify contributions and distributions from the balance sheet and income statement to retained earnings

• Provide recommendations to improve client efficiency

• Prepare and submit client personal property tax filings for Controller review

New Client Implementation

• Review the new client’s current process and procedural documents

• Recommend and document new processes for the Controller to sign off on

• Create initial reports, including Cash Flow Forecast, AP Tracker, Month-End Workbook, and Financial Package

• Delegate updates to the Staff Accountant


Requirements

4+ years of accounting experience

Experience working with U.S.-based clients and exposure to U.S.GAAP

Strong understanding of month-end close, journal entries, and reconciliations

Proficiency in QuickBooks Online or NetSuite (preferred)

Strong Excel skills (formulas, data organization, basic analysis)

Fluent English (written and spoken)

Accounting or Finance degree

Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and problem-solving mindset.

Can work US Timezone schedules 9 am to 5 pm EST

Ful ly remote role with some flexibility included

Paid training in U.S. GAAP and internal processes

Access to TGG University and learning resources

Career development / Long-term growth opportunities within a global firm

PTO after the onboarding period (most local holidays included)

This position is to join us as an Independent Contractor

Payment after 3 months will be based on hours worked (can be 8 or 4 hours per day)

Working Equipment to start is required

PTO before 90 days will be taken as unpaid unless it's a holiday or sick leave

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world, in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.

Loyalty

title: Data Quality Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Quality Analyst em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Their day to day includes accurately labeling machine learning textual data to refine AI models. This will primarily involve annotating large volumes of textual data according to predefined guidelines. This person must be able to read, write and summarize at a high volume and high accuracy. The Pre-screening tests typing speed (45-60wpm), reading comprehension and pattern recognition. Ability to work independently, follow instructions, manage time effectively, and meet deadlines in a dynamic and fast-paced environment. Ability to manage ambiguity, uncertainty, and changing priorities with limited resources. Ability to accept and integrate continuous feedback while remaining professional. What will you do as a Sr. Talent Acquisition Partner at Sealed Air?


As a Sr. Talent Acquisition Partner at Sealed Air, you will collaborate closely with HR Partners and Business Leaders to identify critical hiring needs and build a strong pipeline of passive candidates. You will manage and coordinate all candidate communications, including screening, feedback, and onboarding, ensuring a seamless and positive experience. Additionally, you will take full ownership of the recruiting process, from requisition approval to onboarding, optimizing efficiency and alignment with business goals. This role will also focus on enhancing the candidate experience while supporting hiring managers in making informed talent decisions. Ultimately, you will contribute to Sealed Air’s success by attracting and securing top talent that is aligned with our strategic objectives.


Why do we need you?


· Develop a strong understanding of Sealed Air’s business, competitive landscape, and overall strategy to enhance business partnerships and recruiting effectiveness.

· Attend trade shows and networking events to build and maintain a robust external network, fostering partnerships that generate a pipeline of key talent for current and future hiring needs.

· Support and collaboratively drive the development and implementation of innovative strategies to attract and assess top talent.

· Leverage all direct recruitment channels, including internal and external job resources, social media, employee referral programs, lead generation sources, alumni networks, professional associations, conferences, and industry events.

· Take ownership of the recruiting process, ensuring a seamless and positive experience for candidates and hiring managers from requisition approval to onboarding.

· Provide ongoing support to hiring managers and HR as needed.

· Conduct intake sessions with hiring managers to identify ideal candidate requirements, establish sourcing strategies, align on recruiting processes, and determine communication methods and frequency.

· Conduct phone screenings with candidates and provide structured feedback to hiring managers based on the agreed-upon communication plan.

· Present an overview of Sealed Air’s business, employee benefits, and professional development opportunities, creating a compelling vision for potential candidates.

· Arrange and facilitate interviews, collect feedback, and coordinate post-interview debriefs with hiring managers for all active positions.

· Partner with HR, Compensation, and Hiring Managers to develop and communicate competitive job offers to candidates.

· Work closely with HR and Hiring Managers to gather and provide timely post-screen and post-interview feedback to candidates.

· Maintain accurate and up-to-date hiring documentation for all requisitions, interviews, and candidates within SuccessFactors (ATS) to ensure an audit-ready posture at all times.

· Continuously improve all stages of the candidate and hiring manager experience by identifying opportunities, recommending solutions, and contributing to implementation efforts.


What do you need to succeed in this role?


· There are no education or year of experience restrictions.

Advanced level of Portuguese, Spanish and English required

· Experience with the full recruitment lifecycle.

· Knowledge by covering positions in whatever of the business units below, would be great:

· Supply Chain

· Corporate Functions

· Commercial

· Agile in Microsoft Office.

· Experience in Success Factors

A Doppa conecta pessoas que querem se tornar criadoras de conteúdo a marcas licenciadas do setor de apostas esportivas e cassino online (iGaming), um dos segmentos mais aquecidos do mercado digital brasileiro hoje.

Gravar vídeos curtos (formato reels/shorts) usando apenas um celular, seguindo as diretrizes fornecidas pela Doppa.

title: Controller de Projetos
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Controller de Projetos em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

1.Controlar a esteira de entregas dos projetos e demandas, garantindo o correto avanço dos pacotes de tarefas entre as equipes envolvidas.

2.Receber, organizar e validar as informações dos pacotes de tarefas, incluindo escopo, responsáveis, prazos, dependências e critérios de aprovação.

3.Consolidar as estimativas de horas/homem informadas pelas equipes, analisando sua coerência com o escopo e a complexidade da demanda.

4.Apoiar a composição e revisão do orçamento dos projetos, considerando alterações de escopo, esforço, prazos e impactos financeiros.

5.Controlar a aprovação dos pacotes de tarefas e liberar as atividades aprovadas para as próximas equipes da esteira.

6.Acompanhar o andamento dos projetos e pacotes de tarefas, monitorando prazos, responsáveis, pendências, gargalos e desvios.

7.Garantir que as etapas da esteira avancem somente após o cumprimento dos critérios de aprovação, documentação e aceite estabelecidos.

8.Identificar riscos, atrasos, retrabalhos, inconsistências e bloqueios, acionando as áreas responsáveis para tratativas e ajustes necessários.

9.Manter a rastreabilidade das informações, aprovações, premissas, liberações, entregas e decisões relacionadas aos projetos.

10.Consolidar relatórios gerenciais sobre status das demandas, horas previstas e realizadas, custos estimados, pacotes em andamento, pacotes concluídos e pendências.

11.Acompanhar a aderência entre horas planejadas e horas executadas, identificando variações relevantes e apoiando a análise de suas causas.

12.Apoiar as lideranças na priorização das demandas, considerando capacidade das equipes, prazos, dependências, riscos e impacto financeiro.

13.Monitorar indicadores de performance da esteira, como cumprimento de prazos, variação de horas, tempo médio por etapa, retrabalho, pacotes pendentes e demandas bloqueadas.

14.Propor melhorias nos fluxos, controles, ferramentas e critérios de passagem entre as etapas da esteira de projetos.

15.Apoiar a gestão na tomada de decisão por meio de informações confiáveis sobre esforço, custo, prazo, capacidade e andamento dos projetos.

Career development / Long-term growth opportunities within a global firm

Our vision is to earn promotion through the English football pyramid and ultimately reach the English Football League through strategic investment, strong leadership, and community engagement. Westfield FC also competes in FA Cup and FA Trophy qualifying matches each season, providing exciting opportunities to showcase the club on a national stage while pursuing success both on and off the pitch.


Company Website:


About the Role: Member of the Board of Advisors


Westfield FC is seeking accomplished professionals, entrepreneurs, sports executives, investors, and football enthusiasts to join our Board of Advisors. Advisors will help promote the club, expand our network, identify strategic opportunities, and support the long-term growth of Westfield FC. This is an opportunity to become part of an ambitious ownership group working to build a successful football club for generations to come.


We are also actively seeking advisors from Brazil to help represent and support Westfield FC within their local market and networks.


Key Responsibilities


  • Promote Westfield FC within your professional and personal network.
  • Introduce potential sponsors, commercial partners, investors, and strategic relationships.
  • Provide strategic guidance on club growth, marketing, fundraising, commercial partnerships, and community engagement.
  • Support revenue-generating and brand-building initiatives when appropriate.
  • Participate in periodic advisory meetings and provide feedback on key priorities.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Passion for football and the business of sports.
  • Experience as an executive, entrepreneur, investor, advisor, or business leader.
  • Strong professional network that can support club growth.
  • Interest in sports investing, football operations, sponsorships, or community development.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.


Compensation & Benefits


This advisory role offers sweat equity aligned with advisor contributions and the long-term success of Westfield FC. Advisors will have the opportunity to help shape the strategic direction of the club, work alongside the ownership group, expand their network within the football industry, and participate in an exciting football investment journey.


Why Join Us


Join an ambitious ownership group building a historic football club with a bold long-term vision. Inspired by stories like Welcome to Wrexham, our goal is to build a sustainable, community-focused club capable of climbing the English football pyramid and ultimately reaching the English Football League. If you’ve ever wanted to help shape the future of a football club from the inside while sharing in its long-term success, this is a unique opportunity.


Equal Opportunity Statement


Westfield FC is an equal opportunity organization. We are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and respectful environment and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.


Selection decisions are based on qualifications, merit, business needs, and the ability to contribute to the responsibilities of the advisory role.

description:

We’re looking for an enthusiastic Associate Product Analyst who is passionate about AI, creator tools, and short-form video.   • Curious, proactive, and eager to learn product development methodologies.
  • Comfortable working with cross-functional teams and adapting to a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Personal experience creating content for social media platforms.
  • Exposure to AI-powered creative tools.
  • Familiarity with Agile product development.
  • Experience with basic analytics, spreadsheets, or data visualization tools.
  • Portfolio or social media profile showcasing your understanding of digital content is a plus.

title: Business Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.


1, Document Preparation and Analysis (Pre-Shipment): This phase focuses on ensuring all documentation is correct before shipment. It includes receiving and checking the Purchase Order (PO), the fiscal classification (NCM) of the goods, analyzing draft documents (CI, PL, BL drafts), and initial registration in the system.



2, Shipment Management and Customs Procedures: This stage covers the active management of the process while the cargo is in transit. It involves obtaining the Import License (LI), collecting original documents, validating the Bill of Lading (BL), and continuous coordination with the customs broker and the bonded terminal


.
3, Clearance Monitoring and Closing (Post-Arrival): This phase begins upon cargo arrival. It includes full door-to-door logistics follow-up, cargo presence confirmation, monitoring customs clearance (DI/DUIMP), coordinating domestic transport, and finally, archiving all documents to close the proces


s.
4, Invoice Auditing and Cost Validation: This phase focuses on verifying the accuracy of all operational costs before payment. It includes receiving and cross-referencing invoices (from freight forwarders, carriers, terminals, customs brokers) against negotiated tariffs, operational records, and system data (e.g., demurrage/detention days, storage fees) to identify and dispute discrepanci


es.
5, Payment Processing and Budget Allocation: This stage covers the financial execution and control. It involves launching approved invoices into the financial system (ERP), correctly allocating all costs to the specific import process or cost center, scheduling payments according to financial policy, and serving as the main point of contact for supplier payment inquir


ies.
6, Cost Analysis and Performance Reporting: This final phase focuses on data analysis and strategic support. It includes compiling financial data, generating periodic reports (e.g., total logistics cost, cost-per-container, variance analysis against budget), and providing data-driven insights to support new supplier negotiations and identify cost-saving opportuni

ties.

title: DGB Americas Training Manager South Latam
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para DGB Americas Training Manager South Latam em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

DGB Americas Training Manager – South LATAM

DOLCE & GABBANA Beauty

Location : Brazil

Reporting to: Education Senior Manager


Role Mission

We are seeking a dynamic, strategic, and hands-on Training Manager to lead all education initiatives across South LATAM. This individual will be responsible for elevating brand knowledge, retail excellence, and client experience across Fragrance, Makeup, and Skincare categories

The role acts as the regional guardian of training excellence, ensuring that all distributor and travel retail markets are aligned with global brand standards while adapting programs to local needs. This person will not only execute training programs but also build long-term capabilities within distributor teams, driving sell-out performance and brand desirability in the region.


Key Responsibilities

1. Regional Training Strategy & Execution

  • Own and execute the education strategy across South LATAM distributors and TR markets for fragrance, makeup, and skincare categories.
  • Adapt global training materials into impactful, locally relevant training modules (in-person and digital).
  • Develop and manage the regional training calendar, ensuring alignment with product launches and commercial priorities.
  • Deliver high-quality training across key markets, ensuring consistency and excellence in execution.
  • Manage the training budget for the region, ensuring efficient allocation of resources aligned with business priorities.
  • Partner and maintain close communication with Fashion boutique teams to execute training initiatives, ensuring alignment with brand standards and elevating client experience.


2. Distributor Partnership & Capability Building

  • Act as the main education liaison for distributors across South LATAM.
  • Train and coach local trainers and retail teams to ensure scalable knowledge transfer.
  • Track training effectiveness through KPIs (sell-out, engagement, certification rates) and implement improvements.
  • Tailor training approaches based on market maturity, cultural nuances, and business needs.


3. Brand & Product Expertise

  • Serve as the regional expert across fragrance, makeup, and skincare, ensuring deep product and brand storytelling knowledge.
  • Lead all training-related aspects of product launches, ensuring teams are fully prepared prior to market activation.
  • Elevate in-store execution standards through coaching on client experience, selling techniques, and service rituals.


4. Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Sales and Marketing teams to align training initiatives with business objectives and sell-out targets.
  • Collaborate with Communications, Digital, and Trade Marketing teams to ensure a consistent brand message across all touchpoints.
  • Maintain alignment with brand DNA and guidelines.


5. Innovation & Continuous Improvement

  • Drive adoption of digital learning platforms and hybrid training formats (virtual, e-learning, etc.).
  • Identify and share best-in-class training practices across markets to elevate regional performance.
  • Gather feedback from the field to continuously refine training content and approach.


Requirements & Skills

  • 5+ years in Training/Education within the beauty industry (fragrance, makeup, and skincare preferred).
  • Strong understanding of LATAM markets
  • Proven ability to design and deliver engaging training programs to diverse audiences.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage and influence different stakeholders.
  • Solid understanding of retail environments, client experience, and sales drivers.
  • Fluent in English, Spanish and Portuguese .
  • Willingness to travel frequently across South LATAM

description:

SAP IBP & S&OP Solution Architect


  • Location: Brazil - Remote
  • Employment type: Full-time contractor
  • Compensation: Up to USD 7,500 per month


About Us

LDH by Stefanini is part of Stefanini Group, a global technology company delivering digital transformation, IT consulting, and nearshore talent solutions for enterprise clients across North America and Latin America.


About the Role

We are looking for a senior SAP IBP & S&OP Solution Architect to support a strategic SAP planning and transformation project for a global enterprise client in the automotive manufacturing industry.

The role is ideal for a hands-on SAP planning consultant or architect who can operate between business and technology, lead business conversations, translate planning needs into SAP solutions, and support the implementation of scalable planning processes in a manufacturing environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design SAP S/4HANA and SAP IBP solutions for Sales & Operations Planning.
  • Lead S&OP workshops with stakeholders across supply chain, manufacturing, procurement, sales, and finance.
  • Gather requirements and translate business needs into functional and technical specifications.
  • Document As-Is and To-Be processes, gap analysis, and solution recommendations.
  • Configure and support SAP IBP, SAP APO, and related S&OP planning capabilities.
  • Support demand planning, supply planning, forecasting, inventory optimization, scenario planning, simulations, and analytics.
  • Ensure integration between planning processes and production, procurement, sales, inventory, and finance.
  • Present findings, risks, and recommendations to senior business and IT stakeholders.


Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, and SAP planning solutions.
  • Strong experience with SAP IBP, SAP APO, and S&OP processes.
  • Deep knowledge of demand planning, supply planning, forecasting, and inventory optimization.
  • Proven experience in manufacturing environments.
  • Experience with SAP implementation, rollout, or transformation projects.
  • Strong business consulting or business analyst experience within SAP programs.
  • Ability to lead workshops, gather requirements, perform gap analysis, and create business-facing documentation.
  • Experience working with international or U.S.-based stakeholders.


Nice to Have

  • Automotive industry experience.
  • SAP S/4HANA transformation experience.
  • Full lifecycle SAP implementation experience.
  • Experience with global templates, multi-country rollouts, or large enterprise environments.
  • Strong executive-level communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Familiarity with North American business culture and delivery expectations.


Why Join Us?

  • Work with a global technology organization on enterprise SAP transformation initiatives.
  • Support a strategic planning project in a complex manufacturing environment.
  • Collaborate with international stakeholders.
  • Contribute to high-impact SAP S/4HANA, IBP, APO, and S&OP work.

Apply Today

  • Stay ahead of telecom market trends – Open RAN, 5G and 5G-Advanced, cloud-native CNFs and Kubernetes, observability and telemetry, GenAI and agentic AI for operations, and the shift toward data-driven, autonomous networks – and bring that insight into customer conversations and internal strategy.


Requirements:

Must-have demonstrable skills & expertise:

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication, executive presentation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value.
  • Proven hands-on pre-sales and solution-architecture experience in the OSS domain for mobile operators and/or telecommunication vendors, including ownership of RFx responses and customer-facing technical engagements.
  • Deep, demonstrable expertise across the Service Assurance domain – fault, performance, and service-quality management, customer-experience management, and AI/ML-driven assurance (anomaly detection, correlation, automated root-cause analysis, and predictive / proactive assurance).
  • Strong working knowledge of network automation and autonomy – closed-loop assurance and orchestration, intent-based operations, and the TM Forum Autonomous Networks framework (Levels 0–5).
  • Familiarity with O-RAN architecture and SMO / RIC platforms, including the Non-RT RIC (rApps, R1, A1), the Near-RT RIC (xApps, E2), and the O1 / O2 management interfaces.
  • Exposure to public clouds (GCP, Azure, and AWS) and to cloud service models (IaaS, PaaS, DBaaS), with an appreciation of hybrid / multi-cloud and O-Cloud deployment models.
  • Working knowledge of TM Forum standards and Open APIs / Open Digital Architecture (ODA), and of data and observability technologies (streaming pipelines, telemetry, and data lakes).
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and coordinate virtual, cross-functional bid and solution teams across multiple geographies and time zones, and to manage internal and external stakeholders.
  • Willingness to travel as required.

title: Manager - Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting (Capital Markets)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Manager - Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting (Capital Markets) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role

We are seeking a Manager in Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting to join our growing team. This role is ideal for an experienced accounting professional with expertise in IFRS, US GAAP, and technical accounting matters, particularly in advising businesses through reporting and compliance challenges.


The ideal candidate will have experience in Big Four accounting firms, audit, and accounting advisory services , as well as exposure to multiple industries such as manufacturing, infrastructure, SaaS, retail, and professional services. This role offers an excellent opportunity to gain high-level advisory experience while working with senior leadership and supporting clients through complex accounting matters.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical accounting advisory services , including IFRS and US GAAP conversions, financial statement preparation, and complex transaction analysis.
  • Assist in advisory engagements related to financial reporting, internal controls, and accounting policy implementations.
  • Support CFOs, Controllers, and Finance teams with regulatory compliance, GAAP conversions, and implementation of new accounting standards.
  • Conduct research on technical accounting issues and provide recommendations for best practices.
  • Assist in M&A transactions by supporting purchase accounting, due diligence, and post-merger financial reporting.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve financial reporting and accounting processes.
  • Mentor and guide junior professionals, ensuring quality service delivery and knowledge sharing.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in accounting advisory, financial reporting, or external audit.
  • Big Four or global advisory firm experience is preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of IFRS, US GAAP, and other international accounting frameworks .
  • CPA, Chartered Accountant, or equivalent certification is required (or in progress).
  • Exposure to multiple industries (e.g., SaaS, manufacturing, retail, infrastructure) is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects.
  • Excellent communication and client management skills.
  • Bilingual proficiency in Portuguese, Spanish, or English is a plus.

title: Analista de Compliance Pleno | Sul/Nordeste | Remoto
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Compliance Pleno | Sul/Nordeste | Remoto em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Ei, que bom te ver por aqui! 😃

Você já conhece a ZAMP?


Somos um grande ecossistema de restaurantes que reúne marcas internacionais como Burger King®, Popeyes®, Starbucks® e Subway®.


E, por trás de cada receita de sucesso, estão os Zampers: gente que faz acontecer, que joga junto e que deixa sua marca todos os dias.


Aqui, a gente acredita que o verdadeiro sabor do sucesso é ter espaço pra criar, crescer, liderar e ser quem você é. Usamos tecnologia, inovação e muita parceria para entregar experiências que surpreendem nossos clientes e geram oportunidades para o nosso time. Temos apetite pelo futuro e ousadia para conquistar novos mercados, novos sabores e novas conexões. Porque grandes marcas só existem quando grandes pessoas constroem algo maior do que elas mesmas.


Isso é a Zamp® : um ecossistema de restaurantes e pessoas em constante evolução.


Como será o seu desafio?


Buscamos profissionais com experiência em investigação corporativa para atuar na apuração de denúncias, análise de relatos, entrevistas investigativas e elaboração de relatórios.


  • Atuar na condução de investigações corporativas relacionadas a relatos recebidos pelo canal de denúncias, realizando análise de informações, entrevistas investigativas, levantamento de evidências e elaboração de relatórios.
  • Conduzir apurações relacionadas a desvios de conduta, fraudes e questões comportamentais, garantindo confidencialidade, qualidade das análises e cumprimento dos processos de Compliance.
  • Realizar interface com diferentes áreas e níveis hierárquicos, apoiando a disseminação da cultura de Compliance por meio de treinamentos sobre Código de Conduta e boas práticas.
  • Apoiar investigações presenciais e remotas, incluindo pesquisas de informações, análise de histórico/background check e consultas em fontes públicas e redes sociais, conforme necessidade dos casos.
  • Para as posições remotas, ter disponibilidade para viagens mensais para atuação junto às operações/lojas.


Ingredientes Para o Combo:


  • Ensino superior completo em Direito, Contabilidade, Administração ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento em investigação corporativa, apuração de denúncias, análise de relatos e processos de Compliance;
  • Experiência com investigações corporativas, entrevistas investigativas, elaboração de relatórios e análise de evidências;
  • Experiência em consultorias ou áreas de Forensic/Investigação Corporativa será considerado diferencial;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de canal de denúncias (ex.: Contato Seguro) e plataforma Relativity será considerado diferencial;
  • Conhecimento intermediário em Excel e PowerPoint;
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, capacidade analítica e habilidade para lidar com informações confidenciais.


Informações adicionais:

Benefícios:


• Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;

• Cartão Multibenefícios;

• TotalPass;

• Horário Flexível;

• Seguro de vida;

• Bônus Atrativo Anual;

• Parcerias com Instituições de Ensino;

• Vale-transporte, estacionamento ou fretado;

• Parceria com universidades e instituições de ensino;

• Plano de saúde e odontológico sem coparticipação (inclusive para dependentes);

• Programas de saúde e bem-estar (telemedicina e psicoterapia).

Responsável pelo planejamento, organização, gerenciamento e controle de um Centro de Distribuição, envolvendo as áreas Comercial, Logística, Operações e Administrativa, atuando na orientação e acompanhamento de suas atividades e desempenho, garantindo o atingimento das metas estabelecidas, bem como contribuir para o aumento da participação da empresa no mercado, dentro dos prazos, legislação vigente, padrões de, através de adequada alocação de seus recursos humanos, técnicos e materiais.


Vaga de banco de currículos!

title: Talent Pool - Persons with Disabilities (Banco de Talentos - PcD)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Pool - Persons with Disabilities (Banco de Talentos - PcD) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


Diversity is how we build better

Diversity at Revolut drives better ideas, bolder thinking, and a more inclusive future. We’re committed to increasing representation, especially for people with disabilities who remain underrepresented in tech. That means removing barriers, opening doors, and creating access to opportunity so everyone can contribute, grow, and shape what's next in finance.


Areas we commonly hire for in Brazil


  • Audit
  • Data Analysis
  • Engineering
  • Legal
  • Risk
  • Finance
  • FinCrime
  • Operations
  • Product
  • Recruitment
  • Tax


If you don’t see your area listed above but believe your profile could be a good fit for Revolut, you’re also welcome to apply.


This is a dedicated talent track to support the inclusion of professionals with disabilities.

We move fast and we move together. Real innovation starts with representation, and we’re building a team where different abilities and perspectives are welcomed and valued.


If you apply through this channel, our Talent Acquisition team will review your profile with care. When we find a potential fit with an open role, we’ll reach out to connect you with the next steps in our hiring process.


Who can apply through this channel?

We welcome professionals with disabilities to apply through this channel or any other open roles on our careers page. This is a proactive way for us to discover diverse talent. If your profile matches an open position, our team will reach out to guide you through the next steps in the hiring process.


Can I apply if I don’t identify as a person with a disability?

This channel is specifically designed to connect with talented professionals with disabilities who want to grow their careers with Revolut. If this doesn’t describe you, please check out the range of opportunities on our careers page.


Why is Revolut breaking barriers to hire persons with disabilities in Brazil?

Our Revoluters are our priority. That’s why in 2021 we launched our D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive everyday. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.


Does applying here mean I’m automatically part of the recruitment process?

When you apply through this platform, our team will carefully review every profile. If your skills and experience align with a current opportunity, we’ll reach out to invite you to the next stage of our hiring process.


What if I'm not based in São Paulo? Can I still apply?

Yes. Revolut is a remote-first company that hires talent across Brazil and beyond. Our recruitment and onboarding are designed to be fully remote, and we embrace flexible work arrangements tailored to the role and business needs.


What you’ll need

  • Fluency in English
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Great problem-solving skills
  • Experience in a fast-paced working environment
  • The ability to communicate confidently across all levels
  • A self-starter attitude
  • A solid sense of ownership and ability to work independently
  • High attention to detail


Nice to have

  • Fluency in other languages
  • Practical knowledge of Google Suite


Important notice for candidates:


Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles:

  • Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.


We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.


By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed, if applicable, any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn, or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed.


By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Professor de francês
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de francês em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?



  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

Contract Manager – Activities

As a Contract Manager , you will be responsible for managing and optimizing a portfolio of suppliers, ensuring the product remains competitive, available, and aligned with market needs.

This role combines supplier relationship management, negotiation, reporting, and operational execution , with a strong focus on performance tracking, prioritization, and continuous improvement . Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference

title: Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.

The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes.


Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers
  • Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered)
  • Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)


Market & Network Development

  • Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa)
  • Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape


Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality
  • Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships


Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations
  • Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement


Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners
  • Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets
  • Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics
  • Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM


Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Gerente de vendas
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Gerente de vendas em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

CARREIRAS PARA SORRIR


Na PepsiCo, você descobrirá um lugar onde nossa missão é criar sorrisos em todo o mundo. Com um portfólio de mais de 500 marcas adoradas, incluindo Gatorade, Lay’s e Quaker, nosso trabalho toca milhões de pessoas todos os dias.


No coração da empresa está uma equipe de pensadores, criadores e solucionadores de problemas que colaboram para inovar e transformar ideias em ação. Impulsionados pela inovação e pelo foco em criar momentos de alegria por meio de alimentos e bebidas, nossas decisões são guiadas pela centralidade no consumidor, criando oportunidades para que nossos associados realizem um trabalho significativo e gerem um impacto duradouro nas comunidades que atendemos.


Seja qual for o seu papel, você fará parte de uma comunidade global que valoriza suas ideias e o capacita a causar impacto, tanto em sua carreira quanto no mundo ao seu redor.



A oportunidade


- Responsável pelo planejamento, gestão e controle das operações comerciais no mercado onde atua, visando atingir as previsões de faturamento nos limites de despesas previstas no orçamento;

- Planeja, organiza e gerencia as ações dos clientes sob sua responsabilidade, desenvolvendo estratégias e ações para alcançar e/ou superar os objetivos estabelecidos pela Cia., respeitando a política comercial e mantendo o crescimento sustentável de sua unidade de negócios;

- Assegurar o desenvolvimento dos recursos humanos sob sua responsabilidade;

- Atuar com base nos Valores, Princípios e Código de Conduta.




O seu impacto


- Representar a empresa no desenvolvimento das relações comerciais com os principais clientes da companhia;

- Atingir periodicamente os objetivos de volume, respeitando as políticas comerciais, e metas internas da Companhia;

- Manter a empresa informada sobre as ações de mercado, a fim de alimentar nossas ferramentas gerenciais e indicadores chave de performance;

- Analisar regularmente as ferramentas internas disponíveis além dos demais relatórios diversos de kpi´s, fornecidos pelas áreas de apoio, conectando os dados com as análises de mercado obtidas de store check, visitas comerciais e relatórios Nielsen, para identificar oportunidades e propor soluções, formalizadas em um plano de ação;

- Analisar os indicadores de performance do desempenho dos seus clientes para tomada de decisões;

- Desenvolver a equipe sob sua responsabilidade direta seguindo o Modelo de Desenvolvimento de Carreira da PepsiCo.

- Planejar e acompanhar as entregas, com negociações de volume adequadas às regras de palletização e com o melhor faseamento dentro do mês, contribuindo para solucionar/ eliminar dificuldades de entrega e devoluções de mercadorias;

- Desenvolver o Modelo de Gestão Pepsico para sua região dentro da sua respectiva área de atuação, conhecendo adequadamente seu cliente e atuando como parceiro de negócio;

- Desenvolver calendário de atividades promocionais alinhado com as estratégias da empresa, gerenciando acordos (contratos) comerciais para garantir o crescimento dos volumes negociados, bem como também fortalecer a parceria comercial;

- Garantir cadastro dos produtos nos clientes sob sua responsabilidade e manter a equipe de execução informada a respeito do status do cadastramento;

- Garantir que seus clientes estejam operando com o mix de produtos adequados para a região;

- Propor inclusão de novos clientes importantes em sua região;

- Acompanhar periodicamente a situação de crédito de seus clientes junto ao departamento de crédito e cobrança, e informar qualquer anormalidade financeira dos mesmos.



Quem estamos buscando?


- Formação/Curso: Superior completo em áreas relacionadas à função.

- Experiência sólida na na área de Vendas de bens de consumo, com clientes de pequeno e médio varejo, preferencialmente no ramo de alimentos, atuando como gestor de equipe direta.

- Pacote Office: Intermediário

- Disponibilidade para viagens (rota, viagens curtas)

- Experiência com sistema SAP (diferencial)




Se esta é uma oportunidade que te interessa, te encorajamos a se candidatar mesmo que não atenda a 100% dos requisitos.



O que você pode esperar da gente?



Na PepsiCo, queremos recompensar da melhor forma o seu desempenho e trabalho, cuidando sempre do seu bem-estar integral. Por isso, oferecemos:



  • Remuneração competitiva, com componentes fixos e variáveis que permitirão alcançar suas metas financeiras.
  • Um programa de flexibilidade que permitirá equilibrar melhor sua vida pessoal e profissional, adaptando seu horário de trabalho ao seu estilo de vida.
  • Benefícios como seguros, telemedicina e check-up médico, para que você se mantenha sempre em seu melhor estado de saúde.
  • Com nosso benefício de Auto Executivo, você poderá escolher entre um carro, que inclui também ajuda com combustível e manutenção; ou um bônus de auxílio transporte (apenas para níveis gerenciais L10+).
  • Um programa de bem, com diferentes iniciativas ao longo do ano, que ajudará a promover mais equilíbri o para a sua saúde física, mental e integral -.
  • Programas que ajudarão a cuidar do seu bem-estar financeiro e a alcançar suas metas em todas as etapas da sua vida: Programa de Bem-Estar Financeiro, Caixa de Poupança, Fundo de Poupança e Previdência Privada.
  • Adoramos celebrar o sucesso, por isso contamos com programas de reconhecimento por tempo de trabalho, comportamentos, liderança, momentos de vida, entre outros.
  • E como sua família também é importante para nós, estendemos benefícios como nossa Linha de Bem-Estar, Convênios e Descontos, programas de Bolsas de Estudo para seus/suas filhos(as), Planos de Auxílios para diferentes momentos de vida, entre outros.



Na PepsiCo, estamos comprometidos em promover uma equipe de trabalho diversa, criando um espaço colaborativo, equitativo e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas - independentemente de como nos parecemos, de onde viemos ou a quem amamos - tenham suas vozes ouvidas. Oferecemos igualdade de oportunidades e consideramos os(as) candidatos(as) para todos os cargos, sem distinção de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, religião, nacionalidade, idade ou deficiência.

title: Country Manager- Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Country Manager- Brazil em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About VelaFi


At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we help businesses move money across borders faster, more securely, and more efficiently by connecting local banking rails, global payment networks, and leading stablecoin ecosystems through regulated entities across Latin America, Asia, and the United States.


Our mission extends beyond payments—we are creating the infrastructure that enables businesses to operate confidently in an increasingly connected world. By combining innovative technology with regulatory excellence, we simplify complex global financial operations while maintaining the highest standards of compliance, security, and reliability.


Position Overview

VelaFi is seeking an experienced Chief Executive Officer (CEO) – Brazil to lead the company's Brazilian operations and serve as the statutory executive responsible for the local VASP entity.

Reporting directly to the Global Executive Leadership Team, the CEO will be responsible for the overall leadership, strategic direction, regulatory engagement, commercial growth, and operational performance of VelaFi Brazil. This individual will play a critical role in establishing the company's presence in Brazil, leading local market expansion, fostering relationships with regulators and financial institutions, and ensuring compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements.


The ideal candidate combines executive leadership experience, strong commercial acumen, operational excellence, and the ability to lead a highly regulated financial services organization in a fast-growing global fintech environment. The CEO will also play a pivotal role in leading VelaFi Brazil's regulatory establishment, including executive oversight of the BACEN registration process and collaboration on the company's Brazil VASP licensing process, working closely with Compliance, Legal, and global leadership.


Location

Remote – Brazil

Candidates must reside in Brazil and be legally authorized to work in the country. Periodic travel within Brazil and internationally may be required.


Key Responsibilities

Executive Leadership

  • Lead the overall strategy, growth, and operational performance of VelaFi Brazil.
  • Build and develop the local leadership team and organizational structure.
  • Establish operational excellence while ensuring alignment with global company objectives.
  • Drive execution across Commercial, Operations, Finance, Compliance, and Product functions.

Regulatory & Corporate Governance

  • Serve as the primary executive representative before Brazilian regulatory authorities.
  • Maintain strong relationships with the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN) , financial institutions, banking partners, and other regulatory stakeholders.
  • Lead the company's BACEN registration process, ensuring timely execution of regulatory requirements and coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Provide executive oversight and collaborate closely with Compliance, Legal, and global leadership throughout the Brazil VASP licensing process, supporting regulatory submissions, licensing milestones, and ongoing compliance efforts.
  • Ensure ongoing compliance with applicable VASP, financial services, and corporate governance requirements.
  • Support ongoing regulatory reporting, licensing renewals, and corporate governance initiatives.

Commercial Growth & Strategic Partnerships

  • Develop and execute the company's go-to-market strategy in Brazil.
  • Build strategic partnerships with banks, payment service providers (PSPs), fintechs, enterprise customers, and ecosystem partners.
  • Identify new business opportunities and support revenue growth.
  • Represent VelaFi at executive meetings, conferences, and industry events.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with Finance, Compliance, Treasury, Product, Operations, Legal, and Commercial teams.
  • Foster collaboration across global teams located in LATAM, APAC, and North America.
  • Drive organizational alignment and operational efficiency across all business functions.

Organizational Development

  • Recruit, mentor, and develop high-performing teams.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Support workforce planning and organizational scaling as the business grows.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Law, or a related field.
  • MBA or other advanced degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of executive leadership experience within fintech, banking, payments, financial services, or related industries.
  • Proven experience leading business operations and organizational growth.
  • Strong understanding of Brazil's financial services and regulatory environment.
  • Experience working with regulators, banking institutions, and executive stakeholders.
  • Experience leading or supporting regulatory licensing, authorization, or registration processes with Brazilian financial regulators (including BACEN or VASP frameworks) is strongly preferred.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and decision-making skills.
  • Professional proficiency in Portuguese and English.


Nice to Have

  • Experience in fintech, payments, digital assets, stablecoins, or blockchain technology.
  • Experience launching or scaling financial services businesses in Brazil.
  • Existing relationships with Brazilian regulators, financial institutions, and payment providers.
  • Experience working within multinational or global organizations.
  • Experience with cross-border payments and treasury infrastructure.
  • Experience leading or supporting BACEN registration, financial institution licensing, or Brazil VASP authorization initiatives.


Regulatory Requirements (Brazil VASP)

Candidates selected for this position must be eligible to satisfy applicable Brazilian regulatory requirements, including:

  • Be legally authorized to reside and work in Brazil.
  • Possess the qualifications, experience, and professional competence required to perform executive responsibilities.
  • Successfully complete background checks and regulatory due diligence.
  • Be eligible to serve as an executive of a regulated financial institution under applicable Brazilian laws.
  • Have no disqualifying criminal convictions, financial crimes, or regulatory restrictions that would prevent appointment.


Why Join VelaFi?

At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we connect local banking rails, global payment networks, and digital asset infrastructure to enable faster, more secure, and more efficient cross-border money movement.

Joining VelaFi means playing a foundational leadership role in establishing our regulated presence in Brazil while helping shape one of the company's most strategic growth markets. You'll work alongside global executive leadership to build a scalable business, lead critical regulatory initiatives, and help create the financial infrastructure powering the next generation of global payments.


Guided by our values of Ingenuity, Accountability, Excellence, Care, and a Global Mindset , we empower our leaders to solve meaningful challenges, take ownership, and build lasting impact across global financial markets.


Equal Employment Opportunity

VelaFi is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Head of Risk (Crypto)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head of Risk (Crypto) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Head of Risk (Crypto) (Brazil-based)


About the Company:

We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet — and we're looking for exceptional finance professionals to help shape it.


The Role:

We are in search of a business-oriented Head of Risk (Crypto) to lead the overall risk management function for our Brazil entity.


This role focuses on end-to-end risk management across trading, financial crime, and product risk, while ensuring the company operates within its defined risk appetite while actively supporting business growth.


Unlike traditional compliance-heavy roles, this position is about risk ownership: identifying exposures, calibrating tolerance, and driving real-time control execution. We're looking for someone who understands that well-designed risk frameworks are a business enabler, not a brake.


We welcome candidates with a strong crypto or digital asset background. We are equally open to risk leaders from traditional financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, or payments companies who bring deep, transferable expertise and a genuine appetite to operate in a more dynamic, high-growth environment.


What You'll Do:

  • Establish and lead the company's enterprise-wide risk management framework, covering trading and market risk, product risk, financial crime risk, and operational risk.
  • Define, review, and continuously optimise the risk appetite framework in alignment with overall business strategy.
  • Monitor risk activities to ensure alignment with internal risk policies, business objectives, and applicable Brazilian regulatory expectations, and other relevant regulatory authorities.
  • Partner with senior leadership and the Board to embed risk-informed thinking into strategic decision-making.
  • Build and enhance risk control mechanisms across transaction monitoring and risk indicators, market surveillance controls, and product risk assessment frameworks.
  • Identify and stay ahead of emerging risks in trading, product design, and operations, and lead mitigation strategies.
  • Strengthen internal control systems and drive effective risk governance across the organisation.
  • Support the company's ongoing regulatory engagement and risk governance as Brazil's digital asset regulatory framework continues to evolve.


What We're Looking For:

  • 10+ years of risk management experience within crypto, financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, payments, or digital asset businesses.
  • Deep expertise in enterprise risk management, including risk appetite frameworks, governance, and internal controls.
  • Strong understanding of trading, transaction, and financial crime risks, with the ability to balance effective risk management against commercial objectives.
  • Ability to translate risk frameworks into practical controls and work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Operations to implement them.
  • Proven track record operating at or reporting to Executive Committee and Board level.
  • Strategic thinker with the confidence to influence senior stakeholders and embed a strong risk culture across the organisation spanning across operational, market and liquidity risk.
  • Expert understanding of Brazilian regulatory expectations relating to financial institutions and digital asset service providers.
  • Crypto or digital asset experience is strongly preferred, but we also welcome candidates from traditional financial services with strong transferable risk expertise and a genuine interest in the digital asset sector.
  • Functional knowledge of digital asset or digital token listing processes is preferred.

title: Bilingual Customer Service Representative
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Bilingual Customer Service Representative em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ABOUT MASTERPRO

MasterPro Installs is a U.S. appliance delivery and installation company operating in the U.S. We are an authorized installer for some of the largest retailers in the United States. Our trucks deliver and install refrigerators, ranges, dishwashers, and cooktops in customers' homes every day, and our remote team in Brazil is the voice our customers hear before and after every visit.

THE ROLE

You will be the direct line between MasterPro and our U.S. customers. You will confirm appointments, solve scheduling problems, follow up after installations, and make sure every customer interaction ends better than it started. You will work inside our CRM and operations systems all day; everything you do gets documented, tracked, and measured. Our field teams are scored on customer surveys, and your work directly moves those scores.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Handle inbound and outbound customer contact by phone, SMS, and email: appointment confirmations, rescheduling, arrival windows, and post-installation follow-up.

• Work daily inside our CRM and operations platforms, keeping every customer record complete, accurate, and up to date — no exceptions.

• Coordinate in real time with U.S.-based dispatch and field teams to solve same-day problems: delays, access issues, product problems, and customer questions.

• Drive customer survey participation and satisfaction after every completed job — our teams are measured on surveys, and you own the follow-up that makes them happen.

• De-escalate frustrated customers with patience and professionalism, and turn complaints into resolved cases with documented outcomes.

• Flag recurring issues and process gaps to management — we promote problem-solvers, not ticket-closers.

REQUIRED

• Fluent, professional English — spoken and written. You will talk with American customers by phone all day. Interviews are conducted 100% in English.

• Minimum 1 year of hands-on experience with CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk, Freshdesk, Monday.com, or similar). You know how to live inside a CRM: logging, updating, searching, and following workflows.

• 100% remote readiness: reliable high-speed internet, a quiet professional workspace, a computer in good condition, and a quality headset.

• Availability during U.S. Pacific Time business hours (afternoon/evening in Brazil).

NICE TO HAVE

• Experience serving U.S. or other international customers.

• Experience with Monday.com, scheduling systems, or logistics/home-services operations.

• Spanish, in addition to English — many of our customers are bilingual.

WHAT WE OFFER

• 100% remote work from anywhere in Brazil, on a long-term engagement with a growing U.S. company.

• Compensation in line with experience, paid reliably every month.

• Real growth: our Brazil team members grow into finance, operations, and coordination roles as the company expands into new U.S. markets.

• Direct exposure to U.S. operations, tools, and standards — you will work with modern systems and real automation, not spreadsheets and improvisation.

HOW TO APPLY

Apply here on LinkedIn AND send your resume in English to with the subject line \"Customer Service — Brazil\". Include one short paragraph, in English, telling us about a difficult customer you turned around. Applications without the paragraph will not be reviewed — that paragraph is the first test.

title: Data Entry Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Entry Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This is a fully remote position based in Brazil. You will be engaged as an independent contractor.


Salary: USD $900/month plus performance-based quarterly bonus of up to $400. Includes paid time off, parental leave, and health insurance.


Company Overview

Jones is a vertical AI company that helps real estate and construction firms make smarter decisions about insurance so they can boost efficiency and mitigate risk. Across more than 2.5 billion square feet of real estate and construction projects, Jones enables clients to leverage AI, software, and data to accelerate and strengthen insurance verification, collection, integration, and decision-making across commercial and residential asset classes.

Jones has experienced rapid growth driven by the urgent need to modernize the outdated risk and compliance workflows in real estate and construction. In this position, you’ll be sitting at the heart of our operations team and play a direct role in delivering on our core product promise.


Position Overview

We’re looking for auditors of Certificates of Insurance. No previous knowledge needed, full training will be provided. As the key part of your responsibilities, you'll review certificates submitted by tenants, vendors, and subcontractors, confirm that required coverages are in place, and flag gaps before they become problems for our customers. Success here demands precision, a methodical approach, and the ability to stay consistent under volume. If that sounds like you, we'd love to connect.

Please note that this is a dedicated, full-time position requiring your undivided professional focus; it is not compatible with concurrent employment or part-time arrangements.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We use focused assessments to evaluate fit. If you're detail-oriented and eager to grow, we encourage you to apply.


What You’ll Do

  • Review Certificates of Insurance (COIs) and supporting documents, verifying that coverage meets each client's specific requirements;
  • Accurately input compliance data into our system and flag any gaps or missing coverage for resolution;
  • Follow internal processes and guidelines to ensure best practices are upheld;
  • Collaborate actively with the team to support shared goals and maintain workflow continuity.

Who You Are

  • A clear, professional communicator in English, with strong written and verbal skills for cross-team collaboration.
  • Available 40 hours per week during U.S. business hours (EST).
  • Consistently accurate, with a track record of meeting quality targets.
  • Coachable and growth-minded: you respond well to feedback, document your learnings, and apply improvements quickly.
  • Comfortable following structured workflows and confident enough to escalate when something doesn't add up.
  • Self-motivated and persistent: you work well independently without needing close oversight.
  • Background in insurance, data entry, quality assurance, or any structured, process-driven role is a plus.


Why Join Jones

  • Become an expert in an area of real estate/construction operations and insurance that is undergoing serious digital transformation
  • Join an award-winning company tracking best-in-class SaaS growth month-over-month.
  • Fair compensation with performance-based raises and bonuses;
  • Learn directly from talented, experienced leaders who are invested in your growth.
  • Gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, multicultural startup environment.
  • Be part of a lean, agile team with a strong culture and a big vision.
  • Help Jones execute on a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world
  • Develop a strong understanding of SaaS operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company.


Our culture

Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their role and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward. Elements of our culture that can be seen in every one of our people are the following:

  • Fall in love with problems – We are obsessed with solving customer problems because it’s in our DNA — actively listening to customer challenges and treating them like our own.
  • Give help generously – We hire and nurture brilliant people who are generous with their time, skills, and perspectives. This generosity compounds across the company.
  • Own the outcome – Every day we make vital decisions that shape the future of our company. We hold ourselves accountable to these decisions in order to build a durable, powerful business.
  • Take care of yourself – Building a category-leading company is hard. It can only be achieved by encouraging and enabling our team’s mental, emotional, and physical well-being.
  • Build trust everywhere – Every Jones experience is designed to give our clients, our team, and our industry unshakable confidence in the integrity of the company.
